boundary: Actual packaged Tauri startup and page reloads through direct page-only CDP. Reports contain booleans, timings, and error counts only. No screenshots, private repository/account metadata, OAuth initiation, sign-out, provider writes, or real Git mutations. Demo navigation is explicitly selected and returns to Home.
checks: Packaged Home is ready with safe native auth status and no active consent
Native startup leaves Home mounted and inert while its skip control owns focus
Native startup completes finitely and hands focus to Open repository
Escape dismisses native startup promptly and restores Home keyboard focus
Demo and Home navigation do not replay startup and the app returns to Home
Account connection is preserved without runtime errors or blocked production CSP requests
